decisions.reason: The Heading 3 typography change is owned by its atomic Requirement; the catalog-wide obligation to implement the specified style system remains valid without changing its current attributes.
Changing Heading 3 font weight while retaining its size does not alter the style prefix, naming coverage, condition, or language.
The source decision concerns Heading 3 typography and does not change bullet size, appearance, alignment, or scaling behavior.
Heading 3 font size and weight do not affect Tab-driven sublevel creation or nested-list hierarchy behavior.
The Heading 3 typography decision does not change the required stability or test inputs for pasting legacy content.
Heading 3 typography is independent of pasted-table structure and right-hand column containment.
The source decision does not alter the requirement for reliable manual line breaks after legacy-content pasting.
The specific Heading 3 formatting change does not modify the supported Word environment or general reliability and multi-user expectations.

The same message separately reports the numbered-list alignment requirement and failure, which are already represented in this candidate; the Heading 3 typography modification does not change that requirement.
Heading 3 font size and weight do not resolve or modify the separate conflict over the templates' default document language.
